items.title: feat(pkg): run a PS5 game straight from its package, without installing
items.note:
## Run a PS5 game straight from its .pkg

Installing a PS5 package decompresses every file, so a 206 GB package becomes **~540 GB** on disk. A `.zar` already runs in place; this does the same for PS5 packages.

### How it works
- `App0Archive` now mounts any `IApp0Source`. `ZArchive` is one, and the new `Ps5PackageSource` is the other.
- The package source builds the same tree an install would: `sce_sys` metadata first, then the inner files, which win on a name clash.
- Blocks are decoded on demand into a bounded LRU cache (256 MiB):
  - each block is decoded once, outside the lock;
  - when a file is read forward, the next blocks are decoded

## Summary

Add `add_compile_options(/utf-8)` under `if(MSVC)` in `CMakeLists.txt` so builds succeed reliably on non-UTF-8 Windows system locales — specifically Chinese versions of Windows (e.g., CP936 / GBK).

## Why

Without `/utf-8`, MSVC interprets source files using the active Windows ANSI code page instead of UTF-8.
